subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix inbound image leaves agent turn unresolved; Matrix send queue hits fetch failed, then gateway reloads after ~60s

question: Should maintainers prioritize a live Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room reproduction before allowing a fix PR for #85620?
rationale: Source inspection shows the relevant Matrix send and replay surfaces remain, but the exact `fetch failed` plus unresolved turn plus reload sequence cannot be safely repaired without live proof of the failing path.

options.title: Run live repro, then fix
options.body: Use a live Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room image run to capture the failure path, then repair turn settlement and gateway availability with focused tests.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics first
options.body: Add or prioritize restart/reload attribution and Matrix send-failure logging before changing delivery semantics.

options.title: Defer only if unreproducible
options.body: Keep the issue marked stale only if maintainers decide no one can provide a current-main live reproduction.

recommendation.title: Run live repro, then fix
recommendation.body: Use a live Matrix/Tuwunel encrypted-room image run to capture the failure path, then repair turn settlement and gateway availability with focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history touches both Matrix SDK behavior and gateway restart sentinel code, the two central surfaces that need the maintainer live-repro decision.
